career_overview.short_description: Build intelligent applications powered by Large Language Models, embeddings, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and agentic workflows.
responsibilities: Integrate foundation LLM provider APIs into modern software applications
Design, generate, and query vector embeddings using vector databases
Implement robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines with evaluation
Build autonomous agentic workflows using function calling and tool execution
Deploy AI guardrails, monitor prompt latency and token usage, and mitigate hallucinations
representative_work: A production-ready contextual AI assistant featuring custom RAG document search, structured tool-calling, safety guardrails, token usage tracking, and automated evaluation.
core_skills: Tokenization, context windows, and model pricing
Function calling and structured JSON outputs
Guardrails, prompt injection defense, and safety
LLM observability, latency tracking, and evaluation

roadmap.title: AI Engineer: beginner foundations and starter project
roadmap.intended_learner: Motivated beginner; basic computer literacy assumed, with no prior professional experience.
roadmap.starting_requirements: Computer, internet access, text editor, terminal and modern browser. Most tasks use free software or local runtimes.
roadmap.final_outcome: A production-ready contextual AI assistant featuring custom RAG document search, structured tool-calling, safety guardrails, token usage tracking, and automated evaluation.
